content: Ke vè dà etew is disirtu etawa memaza he menge tanà, ne edlipey heini. Ebpemekar is menge vulak dutun te sibsivayan.

Iring heini te etew su egkanta zaan wey ed-ugyab te kegkelipey, ne ebpemekar is mahabet he menge vulak kayi. Ne egkehimu heini he mekempet iring te Buntud he Lebanon. Ne uuzaran heini iring te pemuleey iring te Carmel wey Sharon. Ne egkaahà dutun is gehem wey utew kegkelavew te Nengazen he Megbevayè tew.
Umbe, lig-eni niw is menge mibmeluya.
Kegiyi niw is menge egkahandek te, “Mebpekelig-en kew wey kenè kew mahandek. Ebpekeuma is Megbevayè niw su ebelesan din is menge kuntada niw, ne edlibriyen kew zin.”
Ne zutun ebpekeehè en is lakap wey ebpekezineg en is bengel.
Edlinglingketew en is piang iring te selazeng, ne egkulahì is emew tenged te kegkelipey zin. Ebugwak is wahig diyà te disirtu, wey edtudà is menge zal-ug pehendiyà te sibsivayan.
Is meinit he pantad egkehimu he wehiǥen, ne is memaza he tanà egkehimu he serebseb. Edtuvù is nekedseselekawà he menge sagbet diyà te menge lugar he ubpeey zengan te leew he menge asu.

Ebeelan dutun te disirtu is meluag he kersada, ne egngezanan heini te “Segradu he Zalan.” Wazà mekesesalà wey tulebung he ebpekeikul zutun. Su para zà haazà te menge etew he edsunud te menge paaǥi te Megbevayà.
Wazà menge erimaung wey minsan hengkey he kelasi te zumezaas he menge langgam he ebpekevayà dutun. Iyan dà ebpekeikul zutun is menge etew he midlibri te Nengazen.
Heini is menge nevelukasan te Nengazen edlikù sikandan diyà te Jerusalem is ebpemenganta. Melipayen dan layun; egkaawè en is menge seeng dan wey menge kegkerasey zan.
